_about: Ingest-time output: one scene spec per picture. Written once per book by the AI pass, then rendered deterministically by src/art.js. Every element must quote the text verbatim; build/build.py rejects any quote that is not found exactly once. The picture is placed after the last sentence it quotes from its own paragraph.

elements.quote: brown belly, slightly domed and divided by arches into stiff sections
The bedding was hardly able to cover it
textile samples lay spread out on the table
a lady fitted out with a fur hat and fur boa
Drops of rain could be heard hitting the pane

figures.title: The boss at his high desk

elements.quote: He’d fall right off his desk!
sitting up there at your desk
the boss is hard of hearing
unable to decide to get out of the bed
a cautious knock at the door near his head
knocking at one of the side doors, gently, but with his fist
At the other side door his sister

skips.p4: ¶4 is Gregor complaining about his job. The one physical detail, an itch, is too small to picture well.
skips.p8: ¶8 is plans and excuses. Nothing happens that you could see.
skips.p9: ¶9 is his struggle with his legs, which the picture for ¶1 already shows.
